about: Placement checks (Words lead, rules 110 to 113, Nov 14): a check reads where a bank piece is placed (its step, role, move and the facts it requires), never its wording alone. Each is a counted report: the count of breaks may only fall (tests/guards/english/placement-baseline.json) and no line is pulled; the Words lead names who fixes each one. Run `npm run words:placement` for the list.

reply-states-only-what-the-record-holds.says: A reply that states the player's own vote or stance needs the fact that says it, or is a marked lie.
statesPatterns: \bI (?:voted|vote|am voting|'m voting|will vote|support|oppose|supported|opposed|backed|back it|stand with|stand against|was against|am against|'m against|was for|am for|'m for|'m in favor|am in favor|don't support|didn't support|wasn't for)\b

opening-reads-its-cause.says: A scene type's opening narration is placed by its cause: at least one narration piece of the type carries a key other than the shared one, so the opening says what just happened. A type with no narration at all is listed, not flagged.
